Name: Flip Buildings
Author: mouahrara
Description:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/FlipBuildings/images/main.jpg[/img]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/FlipBuildings/images/scrolls/01.png[/img]

[list]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New][b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b][/font].[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using [b]SMAPI[/b].[/size]
[/list]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/FlipBuildings/images/scrolls/02.png[/img]

[size=3]Select either the Robin’s or the Wizard’s construction menu, and then click the flip button (↹) to access a view of your farm. From there, you can choose a building to flip. You can also right-click to flip only the draw layers, which generally correspond to the animations of the building. For instance, flipping the draw layers of the mill reverses its rotation direction.[/size]

[size=3]See [url=https://github.com/mouahrara/FlipBuildings/assets/131559634/573ac1fc-1169-40bd-88ea-7caabe1cf72e]demo[/url].[/size]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/FlipBuildings/images/scrolls/03.png[/img]

[size=3]Chinese (thanks to [b]TWBOY[/b]), English, French, German (thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/143711153]ByteBender64[/url]), Korean (thanks to [b]Tofu-Berry[/b]), Portuguese (thanks to [b]kanadeyoru[/b]), Russian (thanks to [b]theRealDuda[/b]), Spanish (thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/198098189]ElGremioMaestro[/url]), Turkish (thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/84417843]BURAKMESE[/url]) and Vietnamese (thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/177241224]Blazemc2k5[/url]) translations are included in the base mod, and contributions are welcome. To contribute, see the dedicated [url=https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-translations/issues/61]GitHub issue[/url].[/size]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/FlipBuildings/images/scrolls/04.png[/img]

[size=3]The mod is compatible with multiplayer as long as all connected players have the mod installed.
In multiplayer, the host player can always flip buildings. For guests, the permissions for moving and flipping buildings are the same. Permissions can be modified by the host using the [font=Courier New][b]/movebuildingpermission [off|owned|on][/b][/font] command in the chat box.[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Courier New][b]off[/b][/font]: Guests cannot move or flip buildings.[/size]
[*][size=3][font=Courier New][b]owned[/b][/font]: Guests can move and flip owned buildings. This includes buildings they’ve built, their house, and their spouse’s house if they’re married to another player.[/size]
[*][size=3][font=Courier New][b]on[/b][/font]: Guests can move and flip any building.[/size]
[/list]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/FlipBuildings/images/scrolls/05.png[/img]

[size=3]Flip Buildings is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] retextures and custom buildings, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12311]Solid Foundations[/url], so you can flip buildings with custom textures and buildings from other mods!
This mod directly modifies parts of [b]Alternative Textures[/b] and [b]Solid Foundations[/b]. This means that changes to these mods may break compatibility, in which case let me know so I can fix it. Furthermore, if you notice issues with one of these mods, make sure they occur without the Flip Buildings Mod before reporting them on the creator’s page.[/size]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/FlipBuildings/images/scrolls/06.png[/img]

[list]
[*][size=3][b]Can I use this mod on an existing save?[/b][/size]
[size=3]Yes, no problem at all.[/size][*][size=3][b]Can I uninstall this mod without any issues?[/b][/size]
[size=3]Yes, but uninstalling the mod will reset all flipped buildings. Reinstalling the mod will flip them again.[/size][/list]
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/FlipBuildings/images/scrolls/07.png[/img]
